sellThenNews.description: r/wallstreetbets 2026 年 9 月 24 日情绪分析。讨论最多的股票代码：ORCL、GOOGL、MU、COST、USO。人工智能生成的零售流程、牛市/熊市叙述和关键主题的摘要。

sections.overview:
1. 整体市场概况和情绪

今日主要事件：

  • Oracle’s “force majeure” controversy weighs on AI infrastructure stocks: According to reports, Oracle sent developer Blue Owl a force majeure notice concerning the Project Jupiter data center in New Mexico to protect itself against rising costs and defer payments if the project fails to come online as scheduled in 2028. ORCL traded at 138.18 premarket (-4.37%), after closing down 3.10% at 144.50 the previous day. Bloom Energy also fell, with BE at 259.46 premarket (-5.69%).
  • Treasury sell-off pressures growth stocks: The 10-year U.S. Treasury yield rose on Wednesday to its highest level since 2007. TLT closed Wednesday at 80.465 (-1.58%). As of 09:25 premarket, SPY was at 764.39 (-0.46%) and QQQ at 734.98 (-0.84%); IWM had closed down 1.80% on Wednesday. GOOGL closed Wednesday down 3.81% at 337.80 and slipped another 0.25% premarket; MU was at 1046.29 premarket (-2.41%).
  • Trump–Xi meeting takes place at the White House today: Bessent announced Wednesday that the U.S.–China “Busan agreement” truce had been extended to January 10 next year. With the summit’s biggest question settled in advance, today’s talks are left to address AI competition, the war in Iran, critical minerals, and other issues.
  • Economic data and earnings: Initial jobless claims last week were 197,000, the lowest since mid-July, while the four-week average was 202,250. BlackBerry reported second-quarter revenue of $163.3 million and earnings per share of 7 cents, both above expectations, and raised its full-year revenue guidance. BB traded at 8.47 premarket (+0.89%). COST reports earnings today and was at 909.34 premarket (+0.54%).
  • Crude oil supply remains tight: Loadings at Saudi Arabia’s Yanbu port have been suspended since a pipeline attack on September 10, and the White House is considering restrictions on some refined-product exports. USO closed Wednesday up 3.32% and was at 150.66 premarket (+1.22%).

社区氛围：普遍悲观且情绪不稳定。甲骨文的“不可抗力”通知和美国国债收益率让许多人将周一和周二的反弹描述为牛市陷阱，但相当多的人仍在押注“开盘绿色”，希望特朗普的帖子或中国协议能够拯救市场。聊天内容一直在末日帖子和逢低买入帖子之间摇摆。

估计的恐惧/贪婪程度：大约 35/100——恐惧，但远未达到投降的程度。许多人呼吁“抛售一切”，但大盘盘前仅下跌 0.5%，仍比历史高点低不到 2%。恐慌情绪集中在个股和期权头寸上；它并没有成为一场全市场的踩踏事件。

WSB 情绪与实际市场走势：社区的末日语气明显比价格走势更为严厉。 SPY 的盘前下跌相当于温和回调，一位评论者嘲笑将“-0.3%”视为世界末日的想法。真正的损害在于人工智能基础设施和资本支出链（ORCL、BE、GOOGL、AMZN、MU），社区的恐惧在很大程度上得到了市场走势的支持。奇怪的是，NBIS 和 CRWV 等“neocloud”名称在盘前上涨，这与“数据中心泡沫已经破裂”的说法不一致。这种脱节导致评论中出现相当大的混乱。
